title: Protomaps makes self-hosted map tiles cheap and easy, blog argues
summary: A blog post argues that self-hosting map tiles with Protomaps has become cheap and easy enough for cost-conscious software projects. It is an explanatory write-up rather than a product release, and the supplied material contains no version, price, or benchmark figures.
